verdict.rationale: Close documents the core of bidirectional sync: writing records via the REST API (with PUT behaving as a patch) and change detection through webhooks that POST Event Log entries plus a queryable 30-day Event Log. Rate limiting is documented via a `ratelimit` response header, but no actual limit values or scale guidance appear, and there is no evidence of upsert semantics. Missing for 10: documented upsert/idempotent create-or-update, concrete rate-limit values and high-volume sync guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync at scale.
